T: It's not a tumour. It's lunch.
D: A tough cop goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher in Astoria, Oregon.
P: Serve the snacks when Kimble blows the whistle in class.
S: snack time for the whole class
Cheddar cut into little squares with crackers, apple slices tossed in lemon so they don't brown, and cherry tomatoes, packed into lunch boxes.
for the class pet, who stays in his cage
Diced mango, pineapple, strawberries and grapes in cups with a squeeze of orange and a mint leaf.
Astoria smoked salmon dip and rye crackers
the Oregon coast town where he hides out

Hot-smoked salmon flaked into cream cheese with lemon, dill and capers, kept chunky, with rye crackers and cucumber sticks for dunking. Flake 200g hot-smoked salmon, removing any skin and bones. Beat 200g softened cream cheese with 2 tbsp sour cream, the juice of half a lemon and 2 tbsp chopped dill. Fold the salmon and 1 tbsp chopped capers through, keeping some chunks. Season with pepper. Serve in a bowl with rye crackers and 2 Lebanese cucumbers cut into sticks.
M: the school lunch special, done properly
Firm white fish cut into fingers, flour, egg and panko, shallow-fried until golden. Oven chips, tartare and frozen peas.
Kimble's rump steak and loaded spuds
the cop part of the job

Rump steak seared hard and rested, sliced over a crunchy green salad, with baked potatoes loaded with sour cream, cheddar and chives. Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 60 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks (250g each) and sear in a smoking pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes. Toss cos lettuce, cucumber and cherry tomatoes with olive oil and lemon. Split the potatoes and load with sour cream, grated cheddar and chives. Slice the steak and serve.
W: for the class party at the end
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, iced with bright buttercream in primary colours and topped with sprinkles.
K: Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, cocoa and malted milk powder until thick and frothy, topped with whipped cream and chocolate sprinkles. Add 600ml cold milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp caster sugar to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 glasses. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream and a pinch of chocolate sprinkles and serve with straws.

s.note: Cheese cubes, crackers, apple and tomatoes packed in lunch boxes
s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into small cubes. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon juice so they don't brown. Pack each lunch box with cheese, a handful of crackers, apple slices and 250g cherry tomatoes shared between them.

s.note: Bright fruit cups with orange juice and mint
s.how: Dice 1 mango and a quarter of a pineapple, halve 250g strawberries and 200g grapes. Toss together with the juice of an orange. Spoon into four cups and top each with a mint leaf. Keep cold until serving.

m.note: Crumbed fish fingers with oven chips, tartare and peas
m.how: Cut 600g firm white fish into fingers. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g panko and shallow-fry for 2 minutes a side. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Serve with tartare and 300g peas.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes in bright buttercream with sprinkles
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint in primary colours, swirl on and add sprinkles.

d.note: Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, cocoa and malted milk powder until thick and frothy, topped with whipped cream and chocolate sprinkles.
d.how: Add 600ml cold milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp caster sugar to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 glasses. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream and a pinch of chocolate sprinkles and serve with straws.
